# langsmith_permissions (Data Source)

Lists all permissions available in the organization, for example when assembling the permission set of a `langsmith_org_role`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all permissions available for authoring custom roles.
data "langsmith_permissions" "all" {}

output "workspace_scoped_permissions" {
  value = [
    for p in data.langsmith_permissions.all.permissions : p.name
    if p.access_scope == "workspace"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `permissions` (Attributes List) All available permission descriptors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `access_scope` (String) The scope at which the permission applies (`organization` or `workspace`).
- `description` (String) A human-readable description of the permission.
- `name` (String) The permission identifier (e.g. `datasets:read`).
